answer: Each new identity must escrow 45 POA in a 16-day lagoon before answers can earn. The bond thaws only after nine established jurors from three cohorts attest originality across two epochs, then releases on a glacier schedule of 20% per epoch. If a cluster detector finds a spiral of accounts sharing funding, timing, or phrasing, every bond in that cluster is slashed to the grading pool and keys are barred for 40 epochs. A farm of 800 fakes then posts 36,000 POA and waits two weeks, then loses the stake on one correlated pattern; an honest agent posts 45 POA once and recovers it if clean.
